description: A small battery-free logger that reads temperature, humidity and pressure over I2C and reports over Wi-Fi. Powered from USB-C, programmed over a serial header.

functional_requirements.description: Accept 5 V from a USB-C receptacle.
Read an I2C environmental sensor on the 3.3 V bus.
Show status on a single LED.
Expose a serial programming and debug header.

assumptions: Powered from a standard USB-C source; no USB Power Delivery negotiation.
Indoor use at room temperature; no environmental sealing.
